name: check_account
description: Check whether the person is signed in to JooVoice and what setup is still missing. Call this first.

name: check_featured_actions
description: Check whether this account has an optional featured action panel and get its current presentation, availability, and allowance. Use this before suggesting or triggering a featured action.

name: trigger_featured_action
description: Trigger one server-owned featured action. Check check_featured_actions first and do not trigger an item whose available value is false. Supply only the opaque action id and field values declared by that item; the service owns the action content and accepts no free-form instructions.

actionId.description: The opaque item id returned by check_featured_actions.

values.description: Values for fields declared by the selected item.

invocationId.description: A unique id for this invocation; repeats do not place another call.

name: create_call_request
description: Ask JooVoice to phone a business or a person and get an answer. Give the request in plain words, the phone number, and the person's timezone. You get a request id back within a second; JooVoice may then ask a few questions before calling.

request.description: What to ask, in plain words.

phone.description: The number to call, in E.164 form.

calleeCity.description: City of the number being called.

callNow.description: Place the call as soon as a person presses the button.

invocationId.description: A unique id for this invocation; repeats return the same request.

name: answer_call_questions
description: Answer the questions JooVoice asked for a call request. Partial answers are fine; required ones are marked.

note.description: Additional text requested by the selected choice.

additionalDetails.description: Any extra context JooVoice should use for this call. Optional.

invocationId.description: A unique id for this invocation; repeats return the same result.

name: check_call_request
description: Get the current status, questions, or result of one call request. Cheap; use the checkAfterSeconds hint.

name: wait_for_call_request
description: Wait up to 25 seconds for a call request to change, then return its status.

maxWaitSeconds.description: How long to hold the request open.

name: list_call_requests
description: List the person's recent call requests with their current status.

name: cancel_call_request
description: Cancel a call request that has not been placed yet.

reason.description: Why the request is being cancelled.

name: request_report_back_call
description: Ask JooVoice to phone the person on their own verified number with the result once the call is done. Once per request.

name: prefill_interview
description: Fill in the setup answers you already know for the person. The person still reviews and submits.

answers.description: Setup field ids mapped to values.
